elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that the Company has “no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation to HDI.”

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity applies at all, so the Company cannot be bound beyond any product category; this is more protective than the stated limitation.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity applies for any period, which is necessarily no longer than 12 months.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: The condition is moot because no exclusivity obligation exists to continue following any service-level failure.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The condition is moot because no exclusivity obligation exists to continue following any delivery-date failure.
